ui_bugs.issue: Cosmetic only. (a) A fraction followed by a space then a letter gets '·' plus the space, e.g. '\frac12 mv^2' gives '1/2· mv²'. (b) A fraction directly followed by a command gets no separator, e.g. '\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{x}' gives '1/2√x' and '\frac12\pi r' gives '1/2π r'. About 8 live strings have a fraction followed by \sqrt or a Greek letter. (c) A subscript with a letter stays raw, e.g. 'K_i'. Reference: src/components/AiSolution.tsx:51
